messages:
ada: pushed regional FP8/INT8 benchmark bundle for kestrel-13b-v2 across H100/A100 in us-west / eu-west / ap-southeast. charts + CSV uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/2103456789
liam: awesome — what were the batch/seq settings and concurrency?
ada: short answer: batch=8 (single-stream) and batch=16 (multi-stream) experiments; seq=1024 and 2048. concurrency tuned per-region. continuous-batching=on for latency runs.
sophia: quick quality note: INT8 on A100 eu-west at seq=2048 shows a small but noticeable regression on our summarization eval (rouge-L -0.9, ppl +3.2%). FP8 stayed within +/-0.2.
ravi: perf numbers (per-GPU, single inference stream, median of runs):
H100 FP8: p50 680 tok/s, p95 620 tok/s
H100 INT8: p50 830 tok/s, p95 770 tok/s
A100 FP8: p50 480 tok/s, p95 430 tok/s
A100 INT8: p50 620 tok/s, p95 560 tok/s
ap-southeast ~10% lower throughput vs us-west for same config.
liam: kernel selection? tiled vs megakernel? any difference in quality for int8?
ada: for these runs: H100 used megakernel for INT8 to maximize throughput; tiled for FP8. A100 used tiled for both (megakernel fallback wasn't available in that driver). kernel choices and args are in the runbook segment: 
```
model.quant_profile: fp8_e4m3 / int8_dynamic
kernel.selection: tiled | megakernel
batcher.max_batch: 16
batcher.concurrency: 4
```
sophia: pasted an example of the regression we flagged (shortened):
```
prompt: "Summarize the policy memo in one paragraph"
gold: "The memo argues for a phased rollout of X with targeted safeguards..."
int8: "The memo argues about rollout X and some safeguards."  // loses nuance about phased approach
```
ravi: capacity sizing quickback: target 200 RPS with avg 1k tokens -> need ~4 H100s (FP8) or ~6 A100s (INT8) in us-west region. eu-west needs ~+12% headroom; ap-southeast +20% for same SLO.
perf-bot: automated artifact: /artifacts/bench_2103456789.csv (sha256: 3f2b...); summary: FP8 gives smaller quality delta vs FP16 and stable p99s; INT8 gives bigger throughput on H100 but occasional degrade on A100 at long contexts.
ada: next steps/action items: 1) run extended eval (10 targeted prompts) for INT8 on A100 eu-west (assigned @sophia). 2) test hybrid attention qprofile (bf16 attention + int8 FFN) as a mitigant next week (assigned @ravi). 3) add tiled->megakernel swap on A100 test matrix to check quality change (@liam).
sophia: taking the eval, will paste diff snippets when done.
liam: will try kernel swap and report perf + any change in rouge/ppl. :thumbsup:
ada: thanks all — if anyone wants raw logs, ping me and Ill drop the GCS path.
